wallet_ledger_sign_matches_kind.name: wallet_ledger_sign_matches_kind
wallet_ledger_sign_matches_kind.value: ("wallet_ledger"."kind" = 'top_up' and "wallet_ledger"."amount_cents" > 0) or ("wallet_ledger"."kind" = 'label_charge' and "wallet_ledger"."amount_cents" < 0) or ("wallet_ledger"."kind" = 'refund' and "wallet_ledger"."amount_cents" > 0) or "wallet_ledger"."kind" = 'adjustment'

carrier_services_transit_valid.name: carrier_services_transit_valid
carrier_services_transit_valid.value: "carrier_services"."transit_min_days" is null or "carrier_services"."transit_max_days" is null or "carrier_services"."transit_max_days" >= "carrier_services"."transit_min_days"

pricing_rules_prices_positive.name: pricing_rules_prices_positive
pricing_rules_prices_positive.value: "pricing_rules"."customer_cents" > 0 and "pricing_rules"."dealer_cents" > 0 and "pricing_rules"."reseller_cents" > 0 and ("pricing_rules"."cost_cents" is null or "pricing_rules"."cost_cents" >= 0)
